pr_title: GameEngine: integrate ACP external agent runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- integrate the provider-neutral ACP AgentHost bridge onto the common ACP core transport
- preserve Agent Host authority over permissions, run-bound MCP writes, validation, and completion
- use the negotiated ACP session runtime identity as evidence

## Integration

This is the first integration slice for the ACP parallel authoring branches. Provider adapters, AI Studio execution routing, benchmark migration, and final lockfile/validation follow on this same Draft integration branch.

## Validation

Dispatcher Windows Validation is required after application.
